errors.text: The proposed 5–10 wt% Ti powder getter would change the nominally equiatomic alloy composition; the target uses titanium sponge as an external oxygen getter.
The specified argon sintering at 1300°C for 30 minutes conflicts with vacuum sintering below 3×10⁻⁶ torr at 1400°C for 18 hours, followed by quenching from 1500°C.
The predicted oxygen content below 0.05 wt% contradicts the approximately 1.0 wt% controlled oxygen level associated with the target result.
The predicted 1–5 µm grain size is inconsistent with the measured 33 ± 19 µm grain size.
The falsification experiment incorrectly identifies alpha-Ti as BCC; alpha-Ti is HCP, while beta-Ti is BCC.
